baseline_models.focus_anchor: جعل فيها رواسي من فوقها وبارك فيها وقدر فيها أقواتها
baseline_models.mechanism: Placement configures the earth with fixed anchors; blessing establishes productive increase, and deliberate measure converts that capacity into life-maintaining provision.

activation_trace.role: Making a thing assume a condition supplies the configuring act that installs the stabilizing system.
Firm fixation supplies the physical anchoring on which the provisioning system depends.
Spatial elevation locates the anchors visibly upon the earth rather than as an unlocated abstraction.
Stable, growing good supplies the productive capacity held in the earth.
Planning by measure and judgment turns raw fertility into an ordered allocation.
Food that sustains life identifies the allocation's bodily function.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists separate acts involving mountains, blessing, and food.
changed_reading.after: The acts form one causal architecture: stabilization supports durable fertility, which is then deliberately apportioned as sustenance.

baseline_models.mechanism: A bounded amount of life-support is brought to a just or even adequacy in relation to requests; equality need not mean identical portions.

activation_trace.role: A quantity brought to its limit supplies bounded calibration rather than accidental abundance.
Sustenance that keeps life going supplies the criterion by which adequacy is judged.
A just, medial, even position supplies equitable calibration among demands.
Asking and requesting supplies the demand side to which measured provision answers.

changed_reading.before: سَوَاءً suggests the same quantity handed to every asker.
changed_reading.after: The phrase can describe provision calibrated to a fair sustaining adequacy for those whose needs or questions call for an answer.

baseline_models.mechanism: Number, duration, exactness, and asking combine so that the temporal clause itself can function as a complete answer to an inquiry about the work's total duration.

activation_trace.role: Exact quantity and limit supply the numerical precision of the answer.
The number four supplies the explicit total.
A duration of time supplies the unit in which the total is stated.
Equality and equivalence supply the sense of a total that comes out exactly.
The asker supplies an epistemic audience seeking the stated total.

changed_reading.before: The four days are only a chronological datum inside the creation report.
changed_reading.after: The clause is also metadiscursive: it gives an exact, resolved total for anyone asking how the sequence is counted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated جعل contrasts constructive world-ordering with the human assignment of rival counterparts, so the focus's material arrangement also argues for undivided ordering authority.

activation_trace.role: Configuring a thing into a condition anchors the focus's constructive act.
The same configuring image is used for assigning rivals, creating the contrast between rightful and counterfeit arrangement.
Creation as measuring and proportioning identifies prior ordering as the Creator's work.
A contrary counterpart supplies the rival arrangement that the earth's coherent order contests.
Cultivation and completion supply the governing agency behind the focus's stabilization and provision.

structural_cues: 41:9 and 41:10 place two uses of جعل on opposite sides of the earth's creation: humans assign rivals, while the Creator assigns stabilizers and sustenance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated جعل, measured creation, rival counterparts, and lordly cultivation; I infer that coherent provision exposes sole ordering authority. A live alternative is that 41:9 merely frames disbelief without narrowing the lexical force of 41:10.

changed_reading.before: The placement of mountains is a religiously neutral physical act.
changed_reading.after: The act is polemical evidence: the one who configures a stable, provisioned earth is unlike those who configure rival claimants to authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth's measured provisions join a larger command system in which domains are directed, comply, receive their own functions, are completed, and are guarded.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate planning anchors provision as an assigned function rather than an accidental yield.
Turning purposefully toward a domain supplies directed transition from earth to heaven.
Willing compliance supplies the responsive execution of the cosmic command.
Perfecting and carrying an act through supplies completion of the ordered structure.
An obligating assignment supplies each heaven with a domain-specific commission.
The returning image of planned measure closes the sequence and links heavenly functions to earthly provision.
Guarding supplies a preservation function alongside nourishment and adornment.

structural_cues: The focus is followed by earth and heaven being addressed together, each heaven receiving its أمر, and the sequence closing with تقدير.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direction, compliance, assigned commands, completion, guarding, and repeated تقدير; I infer a coordinated functional system. A live alternative treats these as consecutive acts without a shared systems relation.

changed_reading.before: Measured sustenance is a stock placed on an otherwise passive earth.
changed_reading.after: Provision is the earth's commissioned function within a responsive cosmos whose domains receive, execute, and preserve distinct assignments.

context_deltas.mechanism: Blessing is latent productive capacity that becomes visible when water is delivered from above: the low earth moves, rises, and produces life.

activation_trace.role: The upper direction anchors the vertical relation later occupied by descending water.
Stable growing good supplies the earth's latent fecundity.
Life-maintaining food anchors revival to the focus's provisioning outcome.
Delivery downward supplies the activating input to the earth.
Water conveyed by pouring or irrigation supplies the material agent of activation.
Earth and plants stirring with life supplies the first observable response.
Increase and rising supply the expansion of the earth's stored productive capacity.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation supplies the completed provisioning effect.

structural_cues: 41:10 repeats فيها around blessing and provisioning; 41:39 returns to the same earth through عليها and أحياها and supplies a descent-to-revival sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vertical delivery, water, movement, increase, and revived earth; I infer that this sequence discloses how the focus's blessing operates. A live alternative is that 41:39 is only an eschatological sign, not an explanation of 41:10.

changed_reading.before: Blessing is an unspecified extra good added to the earth.
changed_reading.after: Blessing is a durable capacity for growth that measured inputs can activate into actual sustenance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured sustenance includes concealed development and timed release: fruit matures inside a sheath and pregnancy carries an unseen load until it is placed forth, all within knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Planned preparation anchors the focus's measure as a process, not only a final quantity.
Sustaining food anchors fruit development to the focus's provisions.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower supplies governance of otherwise hidden stages.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the release stage.
Ripe fruit supplies the mature provisioning product.
The plant's enclosing sheath supplies a protected hidden-development stage.
An inwardly carried load or fruit supplies the gestational phase of the mechanism.
Putting down a carried load in birth supplies the endpoint of timed emergence.

structural_cues: 41:47 balances what fruit exits from its sheaths with what a female carries and delivers, enclosing both processes within repeated علم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, carrying, maturation, emergence, and encompassing knowledge; I infer that قدر in the focus includes scheduling those transitions. A live alternative confines 41:47 to divine knowledge without making it a provisioning mechanism.

changed_reading.before: God measures already available food into fixed quantities.
changed_reading.after: The measure also governs when hidden potential matures and crosses into available provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later denies equality between good and evil while explicitly linking sufficiency to sustaining food; this constrains سواء toward exactness, justice, or enoughness rather than indiscriminate sameness.

activation_trace.role: A just and medial position anchors an equitable rather than merely identical reading.
What keeps life going anchors adequacy as the relevant material threshold.
Equality is explicitly negated here, blocking a rule that unlike things must receive one flat valuation.
Good opposed to ugliness supplies one side of the non-equivalent pair.
Badness supplies the contrasting side that must not be flattened into equality.
Sustenance sufficient for need directly supplies an adequacy bridge back to أقوات.

structural_cues: The same سوى root appears in the later formula لا تستوي, and the surah's final question uses يكف immediately before its appeal to comprehensive witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit non-equivalence and a branch defining sufficient sustenance; I infer that focus equality is calibrated adequacy or an exact temporal total. A live alternative keeps سواء solely attached to the four-day duration.

changed_reading.before: Provision is fair only if every requester receives the same amount.
changed_reading.after: Provision is brought to an exact and sufficient measure; justice can answer differing needs without treating every object, act, or claimant as interchangeable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later asking is restless and asymmetrical: people never tire of calling for good, claim mercy as their own, withdraw when favored, and become expansive in prayer when hurt. The focus's السائلين therefore names beneficiaries whose response to provision remains morally open.

activation_trace.role: Requesting anchors the focus's recipient as an active demander rather than a passive inventory category.
Calling by speech supplies the repeated human request for good.
Failure to tire under repetition supplies the requester's open-ended appetite.
Speech as belief or position supplies the possessive claim that received mercy is simply mine.
A good condition and gift supply the very provision after which the recipient turns away.
Distance supplies the beneficiary's withdrawal after receiving favor.
Renewed calling supplies the opposite posture when harm arrives.

structural_cues: The closing human portrait alternates favor, possessive speech, withdrawal, harm, and extended الدعاء, returning repeatedly to the conduct of a demander.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated calling, inexhaustible desire, possessive speech, favor, and withdrawal; I infer that السائلين carries a diagnostic human edge. A live alternative treats those closing passages as a separate moral portrait that does not qualify 41:10's recipients.

changed_reading.before: The askers are a uniformly grateful class for whom provision is prepared.
changed_reading.after: Provision answers human need without certifying the asker: asking may express dependence, entitlement, inquiry, or distress, and the response to provision reveals which.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah frames its discourse as detailed signs for knowers and closes by showing signs until truth becomes clear and sufficient. The focus's measured four-day clause can therefore be both material ordering and an exact sign-answer for questioners.

activation_trace.role: Questioning anchors an audience seeking intelligible resolution.
A stated quantity and limit anchor the focus as a precise response.
Detail that makes parts and meanings distinct supplies the discourse's explanatory mode.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic outcome of the detailed sign.
Becoming manifest supplies the transition from observed order to recognized truth.
Distant horizons supply the large-scale field in which earth's order is shown as a sign.
Carrying an affair through to sufficiency supplies the criterion of an adequate answer.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies the confirming force of the sign.

structural_cues: The surah opens with detailed signs for a knowing people, places the numbered focus clause near its creation opening, and closes with signs in horizons and selves becoming clear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies detail, knowledge, manifestation, horizon-signs, sufficiency, and witness; I infer that the focus's precision addresses inquiry as well as material need. A live alternative reads للسائلين only as beneficiaries of provisions.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports provision but does not itself answer a question.
changed_reading.after: Its measured temporal and material order is also evidentiary speech: a sufficiently detailed answer offered to those who ask how the world is ordered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates cloud-pulse, fixed-basin, and gradual-consumption branches behind words whose immediate grammar is spatial height, blessing, and food. It remains anchored to فوقها وبارك فيها وأقواتها and gains a visible descent-water-revival mechanism in 41:39; downstream prose should present it as a material systems analogy, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فوقها وبارك فيها وقدر فيها أقواتها

activation_trace.role: Repeated parcels of cloud-water supply a pulse model for inputs arriving from above.
Water fixed in a basin supplies storage between input pulses.
Taking sustenance little by little supplies gradual release or consumption.
Delivered descent supplies the recharge event.
Conveyed water supplies the stored and distributed medium.
Vegetative stirring supplies the observable output of a recharge pulse.

changed_reading.before: Provision is a one-time stock deposited during creation.
changed_reading.after: Provision can be modeled as a calibrated recharge system: intermittent inputs are retained and released into life little by little.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because رواسي in the focus denotes mountains, while the cited رسو branch concerns fixing peace among people. It remains lexically anchored and 41:34 supplies a complete relational mechanism from repulsion to close alliance; downstream prose should mark it as a social echo of physical stabilization, never as the noun's primary referent.

activation_trace.role: Fixing peace between people supplies a latent social meaning of stabilization.
Stable growing good supplies the durable benefit sought by relational repair.
Pushing away harm supplies the intervention that begins restabilization.
A connection between parties supplies the relational terrain being repaired.
Active enmity supplies the unstable initial condition.
Protective affection and alliance supply the transformed stable relation.
Close kinship supplies the final intensity of repaired proximity.

changed_reading.before: Stabilizers belong only to the earth's physical terrain.
changed_reading.after: As a contained social echo, the ayah's stabilizing logic can illuminate acts that anchor a divided human field until enmity becomes durable proximity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the strangest activation because it uses the packet's non-dominant س ل ل mapping for سائلين. It remains anchored to the exact focus occurrence and coheres with water delivery plus fruit emerging from concealment; downstream prose must retain the ordinary asking sense and describe this only as an affordance-image of provision being gently drawn from channels and enclosures.

activation_trace.role: Gentle drawing-out from within supplies an extractability image for access to provision.
A narrow valley channel where water gathers supplies a spatial conduit for accessible provision.
Life-sustaining food anchors the drawn material to the focus's actual object.
Conveyed water supplies material movement through the imagined channels.
Extraction from concealment supplies the release action.
Ripe fruit supplies the provision that becomes available.
The fruit's sheath supplies the enclosure from which provision is drawn.

changed_reading.before: Provision merely exists for people who verbally request it.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch-image, provision is designed to be accessed: water and fruit move from hidden stores through channels into a form that seekers can draw out.

strongest_changes: The focus became a coordinated, knowledge-governed provisioning system rather than a list of independent creation acts.
Blessing became latent productive capacity activated by descending water and completed through hidden maturation and timed emergence.
سواء للسائلين split into coexisting readings of equitable sufficiency, an exact temporal answer, and a moral diagnostic of asking rather than flat sameness.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah cues repeatedly returned the focus's mechanisms through command, revival, gestation, sufficiency, signs, and human asking, allowing physical, epistemic, and ethical readings to remain distinct without forcing one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntactic scope of سواء remains live between the four-day total and the provisions or their recipients.
The moral asking passages may qualify السائلين directly or may only echo it compositionally.
Cloud-pulse, social-peace, and س ل ل channel activations are coherent but branch-distant and require explicit exploratory containment.
